subject: Napoli reportedly want 7 million euros for De Bruyne, PSV say no
title: Napoli want seven million

lines.vo: Napoli reportedly want seven million for Kevin De Bruyne. PSV say no.
De Bruyne is thirty-five, with under a year left on his deal.
PSV reportedly opened with two million. Napoli said no. Five million apart is a different planet.
Napoli are tenth in Serie A. They may need his passes more than the cash.
Allegri reportedly opposes a midseason sale. That makes three noes in one story.
He won six Premier League titles at City. Seven million is about a million a trophy. Bargain.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

facts_used: La Gazzetta dello Sport: Napoli set a 7 million euro price; De Telegraaf: PSV will not pay and reportedly saw a 2 million euro opening offer rejected (ev0059)
De Bruyne, 35, in the last year of a two-year deal; Napoli reportedly will not use a 12-month extension option (ev0059)
Napoli are 10th in Serie A and at risk of missing the Champions League knockout rounds (ev0059)
Allegri reportedly opposes a midseason sale (ev0059)
De Bruyne won six Premier League titles with Manchester City (ev0059 background)
notes: Non-comic, no inserts. Facts unchanged. All fees are press reports, not confirmed. Arithmetic jokes: 7 - 2 = five million gap; 7 / 6 = about 1.2m per title ('about a million'). Three noes: PSV, Napoli's rejection of the 2m bid, Allegri (reported). Personal reasons for the move left out. Source: ev0059.
